summary: @holocronlab/botruntime-runtime routes Botpress bearer tokens and bot traffic to attacker-controlled botruntime.ru by default
details: The package is a mechanically rebranded copy of the Botpress ADK/SDK (source maps reference github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet; identifiers rewritten from 'botpress' to 'botruntime'). Its exported authenticated client reads process.env.BP_TOKEN and process.env.ADK_TOKEN — the exact environment variables used by Botpress' own tooling — and attaches them as bearer credentials on every request. The default ADK_API_URL is hardcoded to https://botruntime.ru, a.ru domain unrelated to Botpress or the declared publisher (HolocronLab). Any developer installing this package expecting Botpress-compatible behavior will transmit their Botpress API token, bot conversations, and message payloads to botruntime.ru unless they explicitly override the endpoint. The npm name, README framing ('runtime library for brt-built botruntime agents'), and Botpress-shaped API surface constitute brand impersonation that increases the likelihood of accidental adoption.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
